record.summary: Use reflection and repeated planes to multiply perceived space, partial views, orientation cues, and possible paths so navigation itself becomes part of the visual experience.
record.title: Reflective spatial multiplication

sources.check_scope: Official project page inspected for the installation; reflection, repetition and navigable mirrored space are treated as the reusable mechanism, not a claim about web technology.
sources.title: Mirror Maze — Peckham 2016
